user.title: Termoweb Local
user.description: Connect to the radio that talks to your Sun Ray heaters directly, with no gateway or cloud in the loop.

data_description.serial_url: Where the nanoCUL868 radio stick is. Plugged into this Home Assistant machine: its device path, for example /dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI_FT232R_USB_UART_XXXXXXXX-if00-port0. Plugged into another machine that shares it over the network with ser2net: socket:// followed by that machine's address and port, for example socket://192.0.2.35:5555.
data_description.station_id: The radio address this integration uses as the heaters' gateway. The heaters are paired to 01, so keep 01 unless you know why you need another value.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the serial port, or the stick gave no boot banner or Q reply. Check the URL and that no other process (nano_rx.py, another NanoCul) already holds the port.
error.invalid_station_id: Station id must be one or two hex digits (00-FF).

abort.already_configured: This serial URL is already configured.

init.title: Termoweb Local options
init.description: Heaters are added by the "Scan for heaters" or "Pair heater" buttons on the station device (or automatically, at setup); rename one from its own device or entity page, and remove one by deleting its device.

data.heater_association_hex: Heater EB association value (id:hex, comma separated)

data_description.poll_interval: How often each heater is polled while idle (default 300s, mirroring the gateway; docs/PROTOCOL.md section 6).
data_description.dev_id: Device id used in entity unique ids and the device registry. Set it to the cloud integration's own dev_id for continuity across a cutover.
data_description.heater_association_hex: Optional 'id:hexvalue' entries (the id, a colon and the 18 hex characters of the association value); a heater with no entry here simply skips this frame at station start.
data_description.pair_heater_seconds: How long the "Pair heater" button's discovery window stays open (default 120s).

error.invalid_poll_interval: Poll interval must be between 30 and 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_association: Heater association must be 'id:hexvalue' entries (the id, a colon and the 18 hex characters of the association value), comma separated.
error.invalid_dev_id: Device id must not be empty.
error.invalid_pair_seconds: Pair heater window must be between 0 and 600 seconds.

poll_now.name: Poll now
poll_now.description: Send an immediate poll frame to the targeted heater instead of waiting for the coordinator's own cadence.

sync_clock.name: Sync clock
sync_clock.description: Send the EB clock-sync frame to the targeted heater right now instead of waiting for the daily sync.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Write the weekly program to the targeted heater and read it back to confirm what was stored.

set_preset_temperatures.name: Set preset temperatures
set_preset_temperatures.description: Not supported by the radio protocol yet; always raises.

set_acm_preset.name: Set accumulator preset
set_acm_preset.description: Accumulator nodes only, none installed; always raises.

start_boost.name: Start boost
start_boost.description: Start Boost on the targeted heater; the duration is fixed by the heater's own boost-time setting, not the minutes field.

cancel_boost.name: Cancel boost
cancel_boost.description: Cancel a running Boost on the targeted heater.

import_energy_history.name: Import energy history
import_energy_history.description: Cloud-only, no local energy source; always raises.

ws_debug_probe.name: WS debug probe
ws_debug_probe.description: Cloud-only, no websocket connection here; always raises.
